installed.title: Installed skills
installed.subtitle: SKILL.md files the host agents pick up from ~/.claude/skills/ + ~/.config/opencode/skills/.

empty.title: No skills
empty.description: Drop a SKILL.md with `name` + `description` frontmatter under a configured root and refresh.

hot.title: Hot on skillhub.cn
hot.subtitle: Live top entries from skillhub.cn (cached 5 min on the server). Click a row for the install commands. agim never auto-runs installs — you copy the command and paste into shell or IM.

detail.howInstall: How to install (pick one; agim never auto-runs)
detail.hint: The two CLI commands need skillhub CLI installed on the host first. See docs/skills.md or skillhub.cn.
